summary: Jianpu Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting unaudited financial results for H1 2026 via Exhibit 99.1. The report details sharp revenue declines across segments due to lower loan application volumes and board-approved wind-downs of credit card recommendation and non-core activities initiated in April 2025. Net income fell to RMB2.4 million from RMB19.1 million in the prior year. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, containing no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It primarily serves as a disclosure of operational performance and strategic cost reductions, with no transactional mechanics or market-moving corporate action requiring special-situations classification.
